target_environment: production VPS /home/ubuntu/mory_assistant and DashScope model API

workflow_contract.goal: Replace all previous model configuration with the user-confirmed current ten models and deploy it safely.
workflow_contract.truth_surface: production VPS /home/ubuntu/mory_assistant and DashScope model API
success_criteria: exact 9 text plus 1 OCR models ordered by expiry with cleared legacy state
temporary failures switch without permanent blacklist and next request returns to earliest model
only explicit quota exhaustion permanently blacklists a model
deployment survives service restart with live model and health receipts
workflow_contract.records_consistency: version, changelog, snapshot, debug history, handoff and production closure receipt

recovery_note: The production business probe observed isolated provider timeouts from the earliest model. They were classified as temporary, switched to the next model without blacklisting, and the deployed next-request recovery probe returned to the earliest model while the persisted index remained zero.
known_risks: qwen3.7-max-preview showed intermittent latency beyond the 30-second production timeout in two isolated long-prompt probes; direct model probes and two other real router requests succeeded, and temporary fallback plus recovery is verified.
